scientific_integrity: The formula follows from a complete analytic lower/upper bound proof; the finite checker is supplementary. The geodesic linear-cost endpoint is previously known and is not claimed as original. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Connected two-sheet circle only; equal weights and strictly concave normalized radial metrics; no arbitrary coefficients, higher-degree classification, or uniqueness of minimizers.
title: Sharp Hölder approximation of the antipodal covering average and a term-count reversal
